$comment: QA bilingual check (agents/qa/src/bilingual.ts). `terms`: Latin-script words and phrases allowed inside Hindi strings because Indian users know them in English (brands, acronyms, product names). Matching is case-sensitive, on whole words. `pairAliases`: a `<key>_hi` whose English text is not in `<key>_en` or `<key>`. `exempt`: Hindi strings that are meant to be in English; each needs a reason. Change by PR and keep both lists short.
